fragility.bound: greedy k_joint is an upper bound on the smallest number of events whose removal makes both intervals include zero
fragility.caveat: events are removed after looking at their influence, so section 3 is an exploratory sensitivity analysis; intervals after removal are not inference
fragility.greedy: at each step remove the remaining event whose removal gives the smallest sign(initial point) x point estimate (negatives fixed); recompute the point estimate, the block interval (the section-2 block draws at every step) and the event_a interval (step 0: the section-2 event draws; later steps: new draws among the remaining events, seed fixed per step)
fragility.interval_status: an interval is undetermined (never counted as including zero) if an end is not finite or fewer than 95% of draws are finite; the path stops at an undetermined interval
fragility.k: k_joint = first step at which the block and the event_a 95% intervals both include zero at that same step (the reading uses k_joint only); k_block, k_event = first step at which each interval includes zero on its own, and k_sign = first step at which the point estimate changes sign, reported only; step 0 = nothing removed
fragility.label: k_joint <= 2 is described as resting on one or two events
fragility.stop_pre: for pre-onset and within-regime pre-onset targets the path stops as not interpretable once fewer than 5 remaining events have pre-onset minutes

guards: notebook-22 per-minute AUCs; notebook-33 GBM - M0 points; notebook-32 pairs, Table-7 points and 500-draw intervals; notebook-36 event-bootstrap intervals; complement points equal the algebraic complement of the notebook-32 rows
inputs: spot cache, notebook-2 catalog, notebook-16 frozen models; stored results of notebooks 22, 32, 33, 36 for guards; holdouts and the prospective folder not read

intervals.block: 2000 draws, 7-day blocks, shared by both systems (paired)
intervals.event_a: 2000 draws: subset events resampled with replacement (all positive minutes of a drawn event, times its multiplicity), negatives fixed
intervals.event_b: event_a draws plus negatives resampled by 7-day blocks (independent draws)

minutes: notebook-33 common minutes (valid, finite M0, M1, GBM, B0 scores, RV decile assigned, evaluation period)
reading_section2: distinguishable (+/-) if the block interval and the event_a interval both exclude zero on the same side; otherwise not distinguishable; pre-onset and within-regime pre-onset differences are "not interpretable" when fewer than 5 subset events have pre-onset minutes; "not interpretable" also when either interval has a non-finite end or fewer than 95% finite draws
status: exploratory; development sample only; no confirmatory plan changed
